    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(cols * cell, rows * cell, "MLP neuron activations");
    for (let n = 0; n < act.length; n++) {
      g.fillStyle = css(diverging(act[n], scale));
      g.fillRect((n % cols) * cell, Math.floor(n / cols) * cell, cell - 1, cell - 1);
    }
    hover(canvas, (x, y) => {
      const n = Math.floor(y / cell) * cols + Math.floor(x / cell);
      if (n < 0 || n >= act.length) return null;
      return [["neuron", `#${n}`], ["activation", fmtNum(act[n], 3)], ["raises", (act[n] >= 0 ? effects[n].promotes : effects[n].suppresses).map(plainLabel).join("  ")]];
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function logitLandscape(logits, width) {
    const height = 150;
    const top = 22;
    const bottom = 14;
    const W = Math.max(300, Math.floor(width));
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(W, height, `All ${V} logits`);
    let min = Infinity;
    let max = -Infinity;
    for (const v of logits) { if (v < min) min = v; if (v > max) max = v; }
    const y = (v) => top + ((max - v) / (max - min || 1)) * (height - top - bottom);
    const y0 = y(Math.max(min, Math.min(max, 0)));
    const bw = W / V;
    g.strokeStyle = colors.rule;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(0, y0 + 0.5);
    g.lineTo(W, y0 + 0.5);
    g.stroke();
    const top3 = new Set(E.topIndices(logits, 3));
    for (let i = 0; i < V; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = top3.has(i) ? colors.focus : alpha("ink-2", 0.55);
      const yy = y(logits[i]);
      g.fillRect(i * bw, Math.min(yy, y0), Math.max(1, bw), Math.max(1, Math.abs(y0 - yy)));
    }
    g.font = `11px ${MONO}`;
    g.fillStyle = colors.ink;
    g.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    for (const i of top3) {
      const label = plainLabel(i);
      const tw = g.measureText(label).width;
      const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - tw, i * bw - tw / 2));
      g.fillText(label, x, Math.max(11, y(logits[i]) - 5));
    }
    g.fillStyle = colors["ink-2"];
    g.font = `10px ${MONO}`;
    g.fillText(`max ${fmtNum(max)}`, W - 70, height - 2);
    g.fillText("ID 0", 0, height - 2);
    hover(canvas, (x) => {
      const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(V - 1, Math.floor(x / bw)));
      return [["ID", String(i)], ["token", plainLabel(i)], ["logit", fmtNum(logits[i], 3)]];
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function drawBar(d, width) {
    const W = Math.max(280, Math.floor(width));
    const height = 46;
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(W, height, "The random draw over the final probabilities");
    const order = d.greedy ? [d.chosen] : d.order.filter((id) => d.probs[id] > 0);
    const segs = [];
    let x = 0;
    for (const id of order) {
      const w = (d.greedy ? 1 : d.probs[id]) * W;
      segs.push({ id, x, w });
      x += w;
    }
    segs.forEach((s, i) => {
      g.fillStyle = s.id === d.chosen ? colors.focus : i % 2 ? alpha("focus", 0.22) : alpha("focus", 0.36);
      g.fillRect(s.x, 8, Math.max(1, s.w - 1), 24);
      if (s.w > 34) {
        g.fillStyle = s.id === d.chosen ? colors["focus-ink"] : colors.ink;
        g.font = `11px ${MONO}`;
        g.textBaseline = "middle";
        let label = plainLabel(s.id);
        while (label.length > 1 && g.measureText(label).width > s.w - 8) label = label.slice(0, -1);
        g.fillText(label, s.x + 4, 20);
      }
    });
    if (!d.greedy) {
      const ux = d.u * W;
      g.fillStyle = colors.ink;
      g.fillRect(ux - 1, 2, 2, 34);
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(ux - 5, 0);
      g.lineTo(ux + 5, 0);
      g.lineTo(ux, 6);
      g.fill();
      g.font = `10px ${MONO}`;
      g.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
      const label = `u = ${d.u.toFixed(3)}`;
      const tw = g.measureText(label).width;
      g.fillText(label, Math.max(0, Math.min(W - tw, ux - tw / 2)), height - 1);
    }
    hover(canvas, (mx) => {
      const s = segs.find((seg) => mx >= seg.x && mx < seg.x + seg.w);
      if (!s) return null;
      return [["token", plainLabel(s.id)], ["probability", fmtProb(d.greedy ? 1 : d.probs[s.id])], ["covers", d.greedy ? "0 to 1" : `${(s.x / W).toFixed(3)} to ${((s.x + s.w) / W).toFixed(3)}`]];
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function stopSpark(upto) {
    const run = state.run;
    return el("div", { class: "spark" }, run.passes.slice(0, upto + 1).map((p, i) => {
      const v = p.draw.modelProbs[EOT];
      return el("div", { class: `col${i === upto ? " is-current" : ""}`, title: `Pass ${i + 1}: chose ${tok.label(p.token)}, P(<|eot_id|>) = ${fmtProb(v)}` },
        el("div", { class: "pv" }, v >= 0.005 ? fmtPct(v) : ""),
        el("div", { class: "barbox" }, el("div", { class: "bar", style: { height: `${Math.max(v > 0.005 ? 2 : 0, v * 100)}%` } })),
        chip(p.token, { origin: "generated", noId: true, cls: "small" }));
    }));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Render: token lifecycle
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function selectedToken(snap) {
    if (state.selected != null && state.selected < snap.tokens.length) return state.selected;
    if (snap.fresh >= 0) return snap.fresh;
    if (snap.live.size) return Math.max(...snap.live);
    return snap.tokens.length ? snap.tokens[snap.tokens.length - 1].pos : null;
  }

  function renderLifecycle(step, snap) {
    const host = $("#lifecycle");
    const run = state.run;
    const pos = selectedToken(snap);
    if (pos == null) {
      host.replaceChildren(
        el("div", { class: "life-head" }, el("h3", null, "Token lifecycle")),
        el("p", { class: "muted", style: { margin: 0 } }, "Tokens appear after the tokenizer step. Then select any token in the context window to follow it from birth to the end of the request."));
      return;
    }
    const t = run.tokens[pos];
    const now = state.index;
    const at = (type, pass, layer) => state.stepIndex.get(stepKey(type, pass, layer));
    const events = [];
    const generated = t.origin === "generated";
    const fedPass = generated ? (t.fed ? t.pass + 1 : null) : 0;

    if (!generated) {
      const seg = run.prompt.segments[t.segment];
      events.push({ when: "Tokenizer", what: "Born from text", detail: seg.kind === "special" ? `The chat template added ${tok.label(t.id)} by ID.` : `BPE made it from the ${seg.kind === "content" ? "message" : "template"} text.`, step: at("ids") });
    } else {
      const d = run.passes[t.pass].draw;
      const rank = Array.from(d.raw).filter((v) => v > d.raw[t.id]).length + 1;
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${t.pass + 1} · sampler`, what: "Born from a draw", detail: `p = ${fmtProb(d.probs[t.id])} after the sampler (model: ${fmtProb(d.modelProbs[t.id])}, rank ${rank} of ${V}).`, step: at("sample", t.pass) });
      const em = run.passes[t.pass].emitted;
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${t.pass + 1} · detokenizer`, what: em.special ? "Not shown" : "Streamed", detail: em.special ? "A special token sends no text to the client." : `The client gets ${JSON.stringify(em.text)}.`, step: at("detok", t.pass) });
    }
    if (fedPass != null) {
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${fedPass + 1} · embedding`, what: "Fed back as input", detail: `Row ${t.id} of the table becomes the vector at position ${pos}.`, step: at("embed", fedPass) });
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${fedPass + 1} · attention`, what: "Written to the KV cache", detail: `Its keys and values enter layers 1–${L}: ${fmtBytes(TOY_KV)} here, ${fmtBytes(LLAMA_KV)} in Llama 3 8B.`, step: at("attn", fedPass, 0) });
      const lastPass = run.passes.length - 1;
      const reads = fedPass === lastPass ? 0 : lastPass - fedPass;
      events.push({ when: "Later passes", what: "Read by new tokens", detail: reads ? `${reads} later token${reads === 1 ? "" : "s"} attend to it. The grid shows how much.` : "No later token reads it.", step: reads ? at("attn", fedPass + 1, 0) : at("finish") });
      events.push({ when: "Request end", what: "Freed", detail: "The server frees the KV cache, unless it keeps it for prefix caching.", step: at("finish") });
    } else {
      events.push({ when: "Stop check", what: "Never fed back", detail: "The runtime stopped, so this token never enters the model.", step: at("stop", t.pass) });
    }

    let nowMarked = false;
    const items = events.map((ev, i) => {
      const next = events[i + 1];
      const isNow = !nowMarked && ev.step <= now && (!next || next.step > now);
      if (isNow) nowMarked = true;
      return el("li", { class: `ev${ev.step > now ? " is-pending" : ""}${isNow ? " is-now" : ""}` },
        el("span", { class: "when" }, ev.when), el("span", { class: "what" }, ev.what), el("span", { class: "detail" }, ev.detail));
    });

    const head = el("div", { class: "life-head" },
      el("h3", null, "Life of", chip(t.id, { origin: t.origin }), el("span", { class: "muted", style: { fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 400 } }, `position ${pos} · ${generated ? "generated" : "prompt"}`)),
      state.selected != null ? el("button", { class: "follow", type: "button", onclick: () => { state.selected = null; render(); } }, "Follow the current token") : el("span", { class: "muted", style: { fontSize: "12px" } }, "Select any token in the context window."));

    host.replaceChildren(head, el("ol", { class: "life-events" }, items), fedPass != null ? readGrid(pos, fedPass, step) : null);
  }

  function readGrid(pos, fedPass, step) {
    const run = state.run;
    const passes = [];
    for (let p = fedPass; p < run.passes.length; p++) passes.push(p);
    const currentPass = step.type === "finish" ? run.passes.length - 1 : step.pass ?? -1;
    const currentOrder = stageOrder(step.type, step.layer);
    const visible = (p, l) => step.type === "finish" || p < currentPass || (p === currentPass && currentOrder >= stageOrder("attn", l));
    const grid = el("div", { class: "readgrid", style: { gridTemplateColumns: `auto repeat(${passes.length}, 18px)` } });
    grid.append(el("span", { class: "rl" }, "written by pass"));
    for (const p of passes) {
      const token = run.passes[p].token;
      grid.append(el("span", { class: "colhead is-output", title: `Pass ${p + 1} wrote ${tok.label(token)}` }, plainLabel(token)));
    }
    for (let l = 0; l < L; l++) {
      grid.append(el("span", { class: "rl" }, `layer ${l + 1}`));
      for (const p of passes) {
        const queries = run.passes[p].positions.filter((r) => r.pos > pos);
        let best = 0;
        let bestHead = 0;
        for (const r of queries) {
          r.layers[l].weights.forEach((w, h) => { if (w[pos] > best) { best = w[pos]; bestHead = h; } });
        }
        const show = queries.length && visible(p, l);
        grid.append(el("span", {
          class: "cell",
          style: show ? { background: css(ramp(best)) } : null,
          title: show ? `Pass ${p + 1}, layer ${l + 1}: up to ${fmtPct(best)} of the attention (head ${bestHead + 1})` : queries.length ? "not yet" : "no later query in this pass",
        }));
      }
    }
    return el("div", { style: { marginTop: "14px" } },
      figLabel("How much later queries read this token", "max over heads · columns: the token that each pass wrote"),
      grid);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Render: transport
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function buildScrubber() {
    const scrub = $("#scrub");
    const run = state.run;
    const segments = [];
    const first = state.steps.findIndex((s) => s.pass != null);
    segments.push({ label: "request", from: 0, to: (first < 0 ? state.steps.length : first) - 1, cls: "" });
    run.passes.forEach((pass, p) => {
      const idx = state.steps.filter((s) => s.pass === p).map((s) => s.index);
      segments.push({ label: p === 0 ? "prefill" : String(p), from: idx[0], to: idx[idx.length - 1], cls: p === 0 ? "is-prefill" : "" });
    });
    const fin = state.stepIndex.get(stepKey("finish"));
    if (fin != null) segments.push({ label: "end", from: fin, to: fin, cls: "" });
    scrub.replaceChildren(...segments.map((s) => el("div", { class: `segm ${s.cls}`, style: { flexGrow: String(s.to - s.from + 1) }, "data-from": s.from, "data-to": s.to }, s.label)), el("div", { class: "playhead", id: "playhead" }));
    scrub.dataset.run = String(state.steps.length);
  }

  function renderTransport(step) {
    const scrub = $("#scrub");
    if (scrub.dataset.built !== String(state.runId)) {
      buildScrubber();
      scrub.dataset.built = String(state.runId);
    }
    for (const seg of scrub.querySelectorAll(".segm")) {
      const from = Number(seg.dataset.from);
      const to = Number(seg.dataset.to);
      const fill = state.index > to ? 1 : state.index < from ? 0 : (state.index - from + 1) / (to - from + 1);
      seg.style.setProperty("--fill", String(fill));
    }
    const total = state.steps.length;
    const segEls = Array.from(scrub.querySelectorAll(".segm"));
    const seg = segEls.find((s) => state.index >= Number(s.dataset.from) && state.index <= Number(s.dataset.to));
    if (seg) {
      const from = Number(seg.dataset.from);
      const to = Number(seg.dataset.to);
      const x = seg.offsetLeft + ((state.index - from + 0.5) / (to - from + 1)) * seg.offsetWidth;
      $("#playhead").style.left = `${x}px`;
    }
    scrub.setAttribute("aria-valuemin", "1");
    scrub.setAttribute("aria-valuemax", String(total));
    scrub.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(state.index + 1));
    scrub.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", stepTitle(step));
    const run = state.run;
    const where = step.pass == null ? "" : run.passes[step.pass].kind === "prefill" ? "Prefill · " : `Decode ${step.pass} · `;
    $("#t-title").textContent = `${where}${stepTitle(step)}`;
    $("#t-count").textContent = `step ${state.index + 1} of ${total}`;
    $("#t-prev").disabled = state.index === 0;
    $("#t-start").disabled = state.index === 0;
    $("#t-next").disabled = state.index >= total - 1;
    $("#t-end").disabled = state.index >= total - 1;
    $("#t-token").disabled = state.index >= total - 1;
    const play = $("#t-play");
    play.setAttribute("aria-label", state.playing ? "Pause" : "Play");
    play.innerHTML = state.playing
      ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 2h4v12H3zM9 2h4v12H9z"/></svg>'
      : '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 2l10 6-10 6z"/></svg>';
  }

  function scrubTo(clientX) {
    const scrub = $("#scrub");
    for (const seg of scrub.querySelectorAll(".segm")) {
      const r = seg.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (clientX >= r.left - 1 && clientX <= r.right + 1) {
        const from = Number(seg.dataset.from);
        const to = Number(seg.dataset.to);
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(0.999, (clientX - r.left) / r.width));
        go(from + Math.floor(t * (to - from + 1)));
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Navigation and playback
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function go(index, announce = true) {
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(state.steps.length - 1, index));
    if (clamped === state.index && state.rendered) return;
    state.index = clamped;
    render();
    if (announce && !state.playing) $("#live").textContent = stepTitle(state.steps[state.index]);
  }

  function nextToken() {
    const next = state.steps.find((s) => s.index > state.index && (s.type === "sample" || s.type === "finish"));
    go(next ? next.index : state.steps.length - 1);
  }

  function play() {
    if (state.index >= state.steps.length - 1) state.index = 0;
    state.playing = true;
    render();
    schedule();
  }

  function pause() {
    state.playing = false;
    clearTimeout(state.timer);
    if (state.steps.length) renderTransport(state.steps[state.index]);
  }

  function schedule() {
    clearTimeout(state.timer);
    if (!state.playing) return;
    state.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (state.index < state.steps.length - 1) {
        state.index++;
        render();
        schedule();
      } else {
        pause();
      }
    }, SPEEDS[state.speed]);
  }

  function bindTransport() {
    $("#t-start").addEventListener("click", () => go(0));
    $("#t-prev").addEventListener("click", () => go(state.index - 1));
    $("#t-next").addEventListener("click", () => go(state.index + 1));
    $("#t-token").addEventListener("click", nextToken);
    $("#t-end").addEventListener("click", () => go(state.steps.length - 1));
    $("#t-play").addEventListener("click", () => (state.playing ? pause() : play()));
    $("#speed").addEventListener("change", (e) => { state.speed = e.target.value; schedule(); });
    const scrub = $("#scrub");
    let dragging = false;
    scrub.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { dragging = true; scrub.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); scrubTo(e.clientX); });
    scrub.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => { if (dragging) scrubTo(e.clientX); });
    scrub.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { dragging = false; });
    scrub.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(state.index + 1); }
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(state.index - 1); }
    });
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest("input, select, textarea") || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); if (e.shiftKey) nextToken(); else go(state.index + 1); }
      else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); go(state.index - 1); }
      else if (e.key === " " && !e.target.closest("button")) { e.preventDefault(); state.playing ? pause() : play(); }
      else if (e.key === "Home") { e.preventDefault(); go(0); }
      else if (e.key === "End") { e.preventDefault(); go(state.steps.length - 1); }
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Main render
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  let runCounter = 0;
  function render() {
    if (!state.steps.length) return;
    if (state.run !== state.lastRun) {
      state.lastRun = state.run;
      state.runId = ++runCounter;
    }
    const step = state.steps[state.index];
    const snap = snapshot(step);
    tip.hidden = true;
    renderState(step, snap);
    renderRail(step);
    renderScope(step);
    renderLifecycle(step, snap);
    renderTransport(step);
    state.rendered = true;
  }

  function init() {
    readColors();
    renderSpec();
    renderPresets();
    buildRail();
    syncControls();
    bindControls();
    bindTransport();
    $("#msg").value = state.message;
    runSimulation(false);

    const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    const retheme = () => { readColors(); render(); };
    if (media.addEventListener) media.addEventListener("change", retheme);
    new MutationObserver(retheme).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-theme", "class"] });
    let resizeTimer = 0;
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => { clearTimeout(resizeTimer); resizeTimer = setTimeout(render, 120); });
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(() => render());
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Life of a Token</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<meta name="description" content="Follow one chat request through a small Llama-style transformer that runs in the browser, from the chat template to the stop token.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,100..900&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: a bench instrument. A control deck on top, a live readout of the
   request state (context window, KV cache, client stream), the pipeline rail
   at the left, a large scope for the current stage at the right, and a
   transport bar fixed to the bottom edge. */
:root {
  --bg: #ECEFF3;
  --panel: #FBFCFD;
  --inset: #F1F3F6;
  --ink: #13171C;
  --ink-2: #58626D;
  --rule: #D3D9E0;
  --focus: #5A43D6;
  --focus-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --neg: #2E6BB2;
  --pos: #CF522A;
  --prompt-bg: #DCE5F1;
  --prompt-ink: #224C84;
  --output-bg: #F5E2C4;
  --output-ink: #7B4605;
  --control-bg: #E5E8ED;
  --control-ink: #46505B;
  --ok: #1D7A4B;
  --halt: #B3261E;
  --font-display: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-data: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  --radius: 10px;
  color-scheme: light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg: #0C0F13;
    --panel: #14191F;
    --inset: #1A2028;
    --ink: #E3E8ED;
    --ink-2: #95A1AD;
    --rule: #29313B;
    --focus: #A08FFF;
    --focus-ink: #110D26;
    --neg: #5C9DEB;
    --pos: #F2865B;
    --prompt-bg: #1B2A3E;
    --prompt-ink: #A9C8F3;
    --output-bg: #3A2913;
    --output-ink: #F3C177;
    --control-bg: #212831;
    --control-ink: #B3BCC6;
    --ok: #4CC48B;
    --halt: #FF8070;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #0C0F13;
  --panel: #14191F;
  --inset: #1A2028;
  --ink: #E3E8ED;
  --ink-2: #95A1AD;
  --rule: #29313B;
  --focus: #A08FFF;
  --focus-ink: #110D26;
  --neg: #5C9DEB;
  --pos: #F2865B;
  --prompt-bg: #1B2A3E;
  --prompt-ink: #A9C8F3;
  --output-bg: #3A2913;
  --output-ink: #F3C177;
  --control-bg: #212831;
  --control-ink: #B3BCC6;
  --ok: #4CC48B;
  --halt: #FF8070;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

:root { padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); }
html { background: var(--bg); }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
button, input, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
a { color: var(--focus); }
.sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
.muted { color: var(--ink-2); }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-data); }

.page {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
  padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  padding-block: 22px 120px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}
.panel { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius); min-width: 0; }
.label {
  font: 600 10.5px/1.2 var(--font-data);
  letter-spacing: .09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

/* Masthead */
.masthead { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 18px 40px; align-items: end; padding-block: 2px 4px; }
.kicker { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.brand h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-stretch: 125%;
  font-weight: 820;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4.6vw, 52px);
  line-height: .92;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.brand h1 .tick { color: var(--focus); }
.brand p { margin: 12px 0 0; max-width: 64ch; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 15px; text-wrap: pretty; }
.spec { overflow-x: auto; }
.spec table { border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 11.5px/1.3 var(--font-data); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.spec th, .spec td { padding: 3px 0 3px 16px; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.spec th:first-child, .spec td:first-child { text-align: left; padding-left: 0; color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 400; }
.spec thead th { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink-2); }
.spec thead th:nth-child(2) { color: var(--focus); }

/* Control deck */
.deck { padding: 14px 16px 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px 28px; }
.deck .label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.msg-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.msg-row input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 42px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--inset);
  font-family: var(--font-data);
  font-size: 14.5px;
}
.btn-run {
  height: 42px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--focus);
  color: var(--focus-ink);
  font-weight: 650;
  font-stretch: 112%;
}
.presets { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
.preset {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--panel);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 11px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 7px;
  align-items: baseline;
}
.preset small { color: var(--ink-2); font: 400 10.5px/1 var(--font-data); }
.preset:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.preset[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--focus); }
.sampler { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(148px, 1fr)); gap: 10px 16px; align-content: start; }
.ctl { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.ctl label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.ctl output { font-family: var(--font-data); color: var(--ink); font-size: 12px; }
.ctl input[type=range] { width: 100%; margin: 4px 0 0; accent-color: var(--focus); }
.ctl input[type=number], .ctl input[type=text] {
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--inset);
  font-family: var(--font-data);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.seed-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.seed-row button { flex: none; height: 30px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; }
.deck-foot { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); border-top: 1px dashed var(--rule); padding-top: 10px; }
.deck-foot button { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--focus); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; font-size: 12px; }

/* Request state: context window, KV cache, client stream */
.state { padding: 12px 16px 14px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(260px, 340px); gap: 12px 24px; }
.state-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.meta { font: 400 11.5px/1.3 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); text-align: right; }
.tokens { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; align-content: flex-start; min-height: 42px; }
.empty-note { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 0; }
.side { display: grid; gap: 12px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.kv-grid canvas { display: block; }
.stream {
  font-family: var(--font-data);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  background: var(--inset);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  min-height: 1.5em;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.stream .fresh { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 24%, transparent); border-radius: 3px; }
.stream .placeholder { color: var(--ink-2); }
.caret { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 1.05em; background: var(--focus); vertical-align: -3px; margin-left: 2px; animation: blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

/* Token chips */
.chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 20px;
  padding: 3px 6px 2px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: var(--prompt-bg);
  color: var(--prompt-ink);
  font: 500 12.5px/1.2 var(--font-data);
  white-space: pre;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.chip .t { display: block; }
.chip .id { display: block; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 400; opacity: .72; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chip.is-output { background: var(--output-bg); color: var(--output-ink); }
.chip.is-special {
  background-color: var(--control-bg);
  color: var(--control-ink);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 5px, color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 11%, transparent) 5px 6px);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.chip .ws { opacity: .45; }
button.chip { cursor: pointer; }
button.chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.chip.is-live { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus); }
.chip.is-new { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus); animation: pop .45s ease-out; }
.chip.is-selected { outline: 2px dashed var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }
.chip.is-dim { opacity: .4; }
.chip.small { font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 5px; }
@keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(1.25); } to { transform: none; } }

/* Bench: rail + scope */
.bench { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 252px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.rail { position: sticky; top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 12px); padding: 12px 10px 14px; }
.rail-phase { padding: 2px 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.rail-phase .big { font: 760 17px/1.2 var(--font-display); font-stretch: 115%; }
.rail-phase .small { font: 400 11.5px/1.45 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); margin-top: 2px; }
.rail-group { padding: 10px 8px 4px; }
.node {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.node:hover { background: var(--inset); }
.node .shape { font: 400 10.5px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); white-space: pre; max-width: 120px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.node.is-done { color: var(--ink-2); }
.node.is-active { background: var(--focus); color: var(--focus-ink); }
.node.is-active .shape { color: inherit; opacity: .85; }
.loop-box { position: relative; margin: 2px 0 2px 10px; padding-left: 8px; border-left: 2px solid var(--rule); }
.loop-box::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -6px;
  top: -2px;
  border: 5px solid transparent;
  border-bottom: 7px solid var(--rule);
  border-top: 0;
}
.loop-box.is-looping { border-left-color: var(--focus); }
.loop-box.is-looping::before { border-bottom-color: var(--focus); }
.loop-note { font: 400 10.5px/1.3 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); padding: 4px 8px 2px; }
.loop-box.is-looping .loop-note { color: var(--focus); }
.blk { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.blk .lbl.is-done { color: var(--ink-2); }
.sub { border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 0; font-size: 11.5px; text-align: center; }
.sub:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.sub.is-done { color: var(--ink-2); background: var(--inset); }
.sub.is-active { background: var(--focus); color: var(--focus-ink); border-color: var(--focus); }

.scope { padding: 18px 22px 22px; min-height: 560px; }
.scope-head { display: grid; gap: 7px; }
.eyebrow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; }
.doc {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 5px;
  align-items: center;
  font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-data);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.doc:hover { color: var(--focus); border-color: var(--focus); }
.scope h2 { margin: 0; font: 760 27px/1.1 var(--font-display); font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-wrap: balance; }
.explain { margin: 0; max-width: 74ch; font-size: 14.5px; text-wrap: pretty; }
.explain + .explain { margin-top: 2px; }
.fig { margin-top: 18px; display: grid; gap: 18px; min-width: 0; }
.fig > * { min-width: 0; }
.fig-label { margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 12px; }
.fig-label .note { font: 400 11px/1.3 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }
.scale {
  margin-top: 22px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--inset);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
}
.scale .label { margin-bottom: 2px; }
.scale b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
.callout { border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.callout.is-focus { border-color: var(--focus); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 7%, var(--panel)); }
pre.code {
  margin: 0;
  font: 400 12.5px/1.55 var(--font-data);
  background: var(--inset);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  white-space: pre;
}
.canvas-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.canvas-wrap canvas { display: block; }
.row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 18px 28px; align-items: flex-start; }
.row > * { min-width: 0; }

/* At a glance */
.glance { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; counter-reset: g; }
.glance li { counter-increment: g; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; }
.glance li::before { content: counter(g); display: block; font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--focus); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.glance .k { font-weight: 650; display: block; }
.glance .v { color: var(--ink-2); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-data); display: block; margin-top: 2px; }

/* Template, split, BPE */
.tape { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; }
.seg-text { padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--inset); white-space: pre; }
.seg-text.is-content { background: var(--prompt-bg); color: var(--prompt-ink); font-weight: 500; }
.legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); align-items: center; }
.legend span { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
.swatch { width: 14px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-block; }
.split-rows { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.split-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.split-kind { font: 400 11px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); }
.chunks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px; }
.chunkbox { font: 500 13px/1.2 var(--font-data); padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-2); border-radius: 4px; white-space: pre; }
.chunkbox .ws { opacity: .45; }
.bpe-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.bpe-card { border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 10px; display: grid; gap: 4px; align-content: start; }
.bpe-title { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font: 600 12.5px/1.3 var(--font-data); white-space: pre; }
.bpe-title .muted { font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; }
.bpe-row { display: flex; gap: 3px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.bpe-tile { font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--font-data); padding: 3px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--inset); white-space: pre; }
.bpe-tile.is-byte { color: var(--ink-2); }
.bpe-tile.is-merged { background: var(--focus); color: var(--focus-ink); }
.bpe-rule { font: 400 10.5px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); margin-left: auto; }
.id-compare { border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 11.5px/1.25 var(--font-data); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.id-compare th { text-align: left; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-2); padding: 4px 10px 4px 0; white-space: nowrap; }
.id-compare td { padding: 3px 3px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; }

/* Data tables */
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
table.data { border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 12.5px/1.3 var(--font-data); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
table.data th { text-align: left; font: 600 10.5px/1.2 var(--font-data); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2); padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: bottom; }
table.data td { padding: 5px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); white-space: nowrap; }
table.data .num { text-align: right; }
table.data tr.is-chosen td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 12%, transparent); }
table.data .cut { color: var(--ink-2); opacity: .55; }
table.data .kept { color: var(--ok); }
.pbar { display: inline-block; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--focus); vertical-align: 0; margin-right: 8px; }
.pcell { display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 150px; }

/* Heads, ribbon, neurons */
.heads { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 18px; }
.kvgroup { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
.kvgroup .label { padding-left: 2px; }
.kvgroup-heads { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; border: 1px dashed var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; }
.headbtn { display: grid; gap: 4px; justify-items: center; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); font-size: 11.5px; }
.headbtn[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--focus); color: var(--focus); }
.headbtn canvas { display: block; }
.ribbon { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px; }
.ribbon .chip { border: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.lens { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; }
.lens .p { font: 400 11px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); margin-left: 4px; }
.neuron-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; align-items: center; }
.updates { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; font: 400 12px/1.2 var(--font-data); max-width: 520px; }
.updates .track { height: 10px; background: var(--inset); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; }
.updates .fill { height: 100%; background: var(--ink-2); }
.updates .fill.is-mlp { background: var(--pos); }
.updates .fill.is-attn { background: var(--focus); }

/* Sampler draw, detok, stop */
.flow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.flow .arrow { color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--font-data); }
.bytes { display: flex; gap: 3px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.byte { font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-data); padding: 5px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--inset); }
.textpiece { font: 600 15px/1.2 var(--font-data); padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--focus); white-space: pre; }
.checks { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 640px; }
.check { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; }
.check .mark { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 700 11px/1 var(--font-data); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink-2); }
.check.is-fired { border-color: var(--halt); }
.check.is-fired .mark { background: var(--halt); border-color: var(--halt); color: var(--panel); }
.check .what { font-weight: 600; }
.check .detail { font: 400 12px/1.3 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); }
.check .res { font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-data); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--ink-2); }
.check.is-fired .res { color: var(--halt); }
.verdict { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 12px; align-items: baseline; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; }
.verdict.is-go { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 12%, var(--panel)); color: var(--ok); }
.verdict.is-halt { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--halt) 12%, var(--panel)); color: var(--halt); }
.verdict .mono { font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink); }
.spark { display: flex; gap: 3px; align-items: flex-end; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 2px; }
.spark .col { display: grid; gap: 4px; justify-items: center; flex: none; }
.spark .barbox { width: 22px; height: 64px; background: var(--inset); border-radius: 3px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; overflow: hidden; }
.spark .bar { width: 100%; background: var(--halt); }
.spark .col.is-current .barbox { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus); }
.spark .pv { font: 400 9.5px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); }

/* Lifecycle */
.lifecycle { padding: 16px 20px 18px; }
.life-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.life-head h3 { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font: 720 19px/1.2 var(--font-display); font-stretch: 112%; }
.life-head .follow { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 12px; }
.life-events { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(175px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; counter-reset: ev; }
.ev { counter-increment: ev; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px 9px; display: grid; gap: 2px; align-content: start; }
.ev .when { font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.ev .when::before { content: counter(ev) " · "; color: var(--focus); }
.ev .what { font-weight: 650; }
.ev .detail { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.ev.is-pending { opacity: .5; border-style: dashed; }
.ev.is-now { border-color: var(--focus); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 8%, var(--panel)); }
.readgrid { display: grid; gap: 2px; align-items: center; justify-content: start; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }
.readgrid .rl { font: 400 10.5px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); padding-right: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.readgrid .cell { width: 18px; height: 16px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--inset); }
.readgrid .colhead { writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); font: 400 10.5px/1 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); max-height: 80px; overflow: hidden; white-space: pre; justify-self: center; }
.readgrid .colhead.is-output { color: var(--output-ink); }

.notes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 12px 28px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); padding: 6px 2px 0; }
.notes h4 { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--ink); font: 650 13px/1.3 var(--font-body); }
.notes p { margin: 0; }

/* Transport */
.transport {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 30;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 93%, transparent);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
}
.transport-inner {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
  padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  padding-block: 8px 10px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 6px 16px;
  align-items: center;
}
.tbtns { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.tbtn { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0; }
.tbtn:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.tbtn.play { width: 50px; background: var(--focus); color: var(--focus-ink); border-color: var(--focus); }
.tbtn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: currentColor; }
.tbtn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
.scrub-wrap { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.scrub-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font: 500 12px/1.2 var(--font-data); white-space: nowrap; min-width: 0; }
.scrub-label span:first-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.scrub-label .muted { font-weight: 400; }
.scrub { position: relative; height: 22px; display: flex; gap: 2px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; }
.segm {
  --fill: 0;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
  font: 500 9.5px/22px var(--font-data);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 32%, var(--inset)) calc(var(--fill) * 100%), var(--inset) 0);
}
.segm.is-prefill { color: var(--prompt-ink); }
.playhead { position: absolute; top: -4px; bottom: -4px; width: 3px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--focus); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; }
.tside { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.tside select { height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); padding: 0 6px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; }
.keys { font: 400 11px/1.3 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); }

.tip {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--panel);
  font: 400 12px/1.45 var(--font-data);
  padding: 6px 9px;
  border-radius: 6px;

<body>
<div class="page">
  <header class="masthead">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="kicker label"><span>Interactive simulation</span><span>LLM internals, documents 00–08</span></div>
      <h1>Life of a Token<span class="tick">.</span></h1>
      <p>Follow one chat request through a small Llama-style transformer that runs in this page. The tokenizer, the four blocks, the sampler, and the stop check all run live, so every number on the page comes from the model.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="spec" id="spec"></div>
  </header>

  <section class="deck panel" aria-label="Request settings">
    <form id="msg-form" autocomplete="off">
      <label class="label" for="msg">User message</label>
      <div class="msg-row">
        <input id="msg" name="msg" maxlength="160" spellcheck="false">
        <button class="btn-run" type="submit">Run</button>
      </div>
      <div class="presets" id="presets" aria-label="Example messages"></div>
    </form>
    <div>
      <span class="label">Sampler and stop settings</span>
      <div class="sampler">
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="temperature">Temperature <output id="temperature-out"></output></label>
          <input type="range" id="temperature" min="0" max="2" step="0.05">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="top-p">Top-p <output id="top-p-out"></output></label>
          <input type="range" id="top-p" min="0.05" max="1" step="0.01">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="penalty">Repetition penalty <output id="penalty-out"></output></label>
          <input type="range" id="penalty" min="1" max="3" step="0.05">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="top-k">Top-k (0 = off)</label>
          <input type="number" id="top-k" min="0" max="582" step="1">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="max-tokens">Max tokens</label>
          <input type="number" id="max-tokens" min="1" max="60" step="1">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="seed">Seed</label>
          <div class="seed-row"><input type="number" id="seed" min="0" max="999999" step="1"><button type="button" id="new-seed">New</button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="stop-seq">Stop sequence</label>
          <input type="text" id="stop-seq" maxlength="20" placeholder="none" spellcheck="false">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="deck-foot">
      <span id="defaults-note">Defaults: temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.9, as in the generation_config.json of Llama 3 8B Instruct.</span>
      <button type="button" id="reset-settings">Reset settings</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="state panel" aria-label="Request state">
    <div>
      <div class="state-head"><span class="label">Context window</span><span class="meta" id="ctx-meta"></span></div>
      <div class="tokens" id="ctx-tokens"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="side">
      <div>
        <div class="state-head"><span class="label">KV cache</span><span class="meta" id="kv-meta"></span></div>
        <div class="kv-grid" id="kv-grid"></div>

      <div>
        <div class="state-head"><span class="label">Client receives</span><span class="meta" id="stream-meta"></span></div>
        <div class="stream" id="stream"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="bench">
    <nav class="rail panel" id="rail" aria-label="Pipeline stages"></nav>
    <section class="scope panel" id="scope" aria-labelledby="scope-title"></section>
  </div>

  <section class="lifecycle panel" id="lifecycle" aria-label="Token lifecycle"></section>

  <footer class="notes">
    <div>
      <h4>What is real here</h4>
      <p>The model is a real transformer with 296,256 parameters. It trained for about a minute on a laptop CPU, on 60,000 short chat transcripts about 16 animals. It knows those facts and little else, so other questions give confident nonsense.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <h4>What a real server does differently</h4>
      <p>A real server runs a model about 27,000 times larger on GPUs, with many requests in one batch, a paged KV cache, and fused kernels. This page runs one request in plain JavaScript. It feeds the prompt one position at a time, which gives the same numbers as one parallel prefill pass.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <h4>Source</h4>
      <p>The page, the engine, and the training script are in the <span class="mono">simulation/</span> folder of the research repository. Its README explains how to rebuild the model.</p>
