<script src="engine.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const E = window.TokenEngine;
  const model = new E.Model(window.TOY_MODEL);
  const tok = model.tokenizer;
  const cfg = model.config;
  const V = cfg.vocab_size;
  const D = cfg.dim;
  const L = cfg.n_layers;
  const H = cfg.n_heads;
  const GROUP = cfg.n_heads / cfg.n_kv_heads;
  const EOT = tok.special["<|eot_id|>"];
  const MONO = '"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace';

  // Llama 3 8B, from its config.json and the Llama 3 paper (see sources.md).
  const LLAMA = { layers: 32, dim: 4096, heads: 32, kvHeads: 8, headDim: 128, hidden: 14336, vocab: 128256, context: 8192, params: 8030261248 };
  const BYTES = 2; // both models at 2 bytes per number (bf16) in every size comparison
  const TOY_KV = 2 * L * cfg.n_kv_heads * model.headDim * BYTES;
  const LLAMA_KV = 2 * LLAMA.layers * LLAMA.kvHeads * LLAMA.headDim * BYTES;
  const GPU_BYTES_PER_S = 2e12; // the rough data-center GPU bandwidth in document 08

  const DEFAULTS = { temperature: 0.6, topK: 0, topP: 0.9, repetitionPenalty: 1, maxTokens: 48, seed: 7, stop: [] };
  const PRESETS = [
    { text: "What does the cat eat?", note: "one fact" },
    { text: "Tell me about the owl.", note: "three sentences" },
    { text: "Tell me a fact.", note: "uncertain stop" },
    { text: "Pick an animal.", note: "random pick" },
    { text: "What does the zebra eat?", note: "unknown animal" },
    { text: "Who are you?", note: "small talk" },
  ];

  // The same requests in the real Llama 3 tokenizer, with the chat template applied.
  const LLAMA_TOKENS = {
    "What does the cat eat?": [[128000, "<|begin_of_text|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [882, "user"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"], [3923, "What"], [1587, " does"], [279, " the"], [8415, " cat"], [8343, " eat"], [30, "?"], [128009, "<|eot_id|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [78191, "assistant"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"]],
    "Tell me about the owl.": [[128000, "<|begin_of_text|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [882, "user"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"], [41551, "Tell"], [757, " me"], [922, " about"], [279, " the"], [53369, " owl"], [13, "."], [128009, "<|eot_id|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [78191, "assistant"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"]],
    "Tell me a fact.": [[128000, "<|begin_of_text|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [882, "user"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"], [41551, "Tell"], [757, " me"], [264, " a"], [2144, " fact"], [13, "."], [128009, "<|eot_id|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [78191, "assistant"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"]],
    "Pick an animal.": [[128000, "<|begin_of_text|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [882, "user"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"], [38053, "Pick"], [459, " an"], [10065, " animal"], [13, "."], [128009, "<|eot_id|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [78191, "assistant"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"]],
    "What does the zebra eat?": [[128000, "<|begin_of_text|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [882, "user"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"], [3923, "What"], [1587, " does"], [279, " the"], [1167, " z"], [51313, "ebra"], [8343, " eat"], [30, "?"], [128009, "<|eot_id|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [78191, "assistant"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"]],
    "Who are you?": [[128000, "<|begin_of_text|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [882, "user"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"], [15546, "Who"], [527, " are"], [499, " you"], [30, "?"], [128009, "<|eot_id|>"], [128006, "<|start_header_id|>"], [78191, "assistant"], [128007, "<|end_header_id|>"], [271, "\n\n"]],
  };

  const DOCS_BASE = "https://github.com/d-gubert/assets/blob/llm-research/";
  const DOCS = {
    "00": ["00-big-picture.md", "Big picture"],
    "01": ["01-tokenizer.md", "Tokenizer"],
    "02": ["02-tensors-and-weights.md", "Tensors and weights"],
    "03": ["03-embeddings-and-positions.md", "Embeddings and positions"],
    "04": ["04-transformer-block.md", "Transformer block"],
    "05": ["05-attention.md", "Attention"],
    "06": ["06-mlp-and-neurons.md", "MLP and neurons"],
    "07": ["07-output-and-sampling.md", "Output and sampling"],
    "08": ["08-inference-runtime.md", "Inference runtime"],
    "13": ["13-interpretability.md", "Interpretability"],
  };

  const SPEEDS = { "0.5": 1900, "1": 1000, "2": 500, "4": 230 };

  const state = {
    message: PRESETS[0].text,
    settings: Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS),
    run: null,
    steps: [],
    stepIndex: new Map(),
    index: 0,
    playing: false,
    timer: 0,
    speed: "1",
    head: 0,
    query: null,
    mlpPos: null,
    selected: null,
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Small helpers
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);

  function el(tag, props, ...children) {
    const node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (props) {
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(props)) {
        if (value == null || value === false) continue;
        if (key === "class") node.className = value;
        else if (key === "style") Object.assign(node.style, value);
        else if (key.startsWith("on")) node.addEventListener(key.slice(2), value);
        else node.setAttribute(key, value === true ? "" : value);
      }
    }
    for (const child of children.flat(Infinity)) {
      if (child == null || child === false) continue;
      node.append(child instanceof Node ? child : document.createTextNode(String(child)));
    }
    return node;
  }

  const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US");
  const fmtInt = (n) => nf.format(n);

  function fmtBytes(b) {
    if (b < 1024) return `${Math.round(b)} B`;
    const units = ["KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB"];
    let v = b / 1024;
    let i = 0;
    while (v >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { v /= 1024; i++; }
    return `${v >= 100 ? v.toFixed(0) : v >= 10 ? v.toFixed(1) : v.toFixed(2)} ${units[i]}`;
  }

  function fmtDecimalBytes(b) {
    const units = ["B", "kB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
    let v = b;
    let i = 0;
    while (v >= 1000 && i < units.length - 1) { v /= 1000; i++; }
    return `${v >= 100 ? v.toFixed(0) : v >= 10 ? v.toFixed(1) : v.toFixed(2)} ${units[i]}`;
  }

  function fmtFlops(f) {
    const units = ["", "k", "M", "G", "T", "P"];
    let v = f;
    let i = 0;
    while (v >= 1000 && i < units.length - 1) { v /= 1000; i++; }
    return `${v >= 100 ? v.toFixed(0) : v >= 10 ? v.toFixed(1) : v.toFixed(2)} ${units[i]}FLOP`;
  }

  function fmtProb(p) {
    if (p >= 0.9995) return "1.000";
    if (p === 0) return "0";
    if (p < 0.0005) return "<0.001";
    return p.toFixed(3);
  }

  function fmtPct(p) {
    if (p >= 0.995) return "100%";
    if (p === 0) return "0%";
    if (p < 0.005) return "<1%";
    return `${Math.round(p * 100)}%`;
  }

  const fmtNum = (x, d = 2) => (x < 0 ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(d);

  function visibleText(text) {
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    let buf = "";
    const flush = () => { if (buf) { frag.append(buf); buf = ""; } };
    for (const ch of text) {
      const mark = ch === " " ? "·" : ch === "\n" ? "↵" : ch === "\t" ? "⇥" : null;
      if (mark) { flush(); frag.append(el("span", { class: "ws" }, mark)); }
      else buf += ch;
    }
    flush();
    return frag;
  }

  function plainLabel(id) {
    const text = tok.label(id);
    if (tok.isSpecial(id)) return text;
    return text.replace(/ /g, "·").replace(/\n/g, "↵").replace(/\t/g, "⇥");
  }

  function tokenGlyphs(id) {
    return tok.isSpecial(id) ? document.createTextNode(tok.label(id)) : visibleText(tok.label(id));
  }

  function chip(id, opts = {}) {
    const kind = tok.isSpecial(id) ? "special" : opts.origin === "generated" ? "output" : "prompt";
    const node = el(opts.button ? "button" : "span", {
      class: `chip is-${kind}${opts.cls ? " " + opts.cls : ""}`,
      type: opts.button ? "button" : null,
      title: opts.title || null,
    });
    node.append(el("span", { class: "t" }, tokenGlyphs(id)));
    if (opts.sub != null) node.append(el("span", { class: "id" }, opts.sub));
    else if (!opts.noId) node.append(el("span", { class: "id" }, String(id)));
    return node;
  }

  function docLink(num) {
    const [file, title] = DOCS[num];
    return el("a", { class: "doc", href: DOCS_BASE + file, target: "_blank", rel: "noopener" }, `Doc ${num} · ${title}`);
  }

  function figLabel(text, note) {
    return el("div", { class: "fig-label" }, el("span", { class: "label" }, text), note ? el("span", { class: "note" }, note) : null);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Colors for canvas drawings, read from the theme tokens
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  let colors = null;
  const imageCache = new Map();

  function hexToRgb(hex) {
    const n = parseInt(hex.replace("#", ""), 16);
    return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
  }

  function readColors() {
    const style = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
    colors = {};
    for (const name of ["panel", "inset", "ink", "ink-2", "rule", "focus", "focus-ink", "neg", "pos", "halt", "prompt-bg", "output-bg"]) {
      const value = style.getPropertyValue("--" + name).trim() || "#888888";
      colors[name] = value;
      colors[name + ":rgb"] = hexToRgb(value);
    }
    imageCache.clear();
  }

  const css = (rgb) => `rgb(${rgb[0] | 0},${rgb[1] | 0},${rgb[2] | 0})`;
  const alpha = (name, a) => { const c = colors[name + ":rgb"]; return `rgba(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]},${a})`; };

  function mix(a, b, t) {
    return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t];
  }

  /** Signed values: blue below zero, orange above, the panel color at zero. */
  function diverging(v, scale) {
    const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, v / (scale || 1)));
    return mix(colors["panel:rgb"], t >= 0 ? colors["pos:rgb"] : colors["neg:rgb"], Math.pow(Math.abs(t), 0.8));
  }

  /** Weights and probabilities from 0 to 1, in the focus color. */
  function ramp(t) {
    return mix(colors["panel:rgb"], colors["focus:rgb"], Math.pow(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t)), 0.6));
  }

  function robustScale(values) {
    const abs = Array.from(values, Math.abs).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return abs[Math.floor((abs.length - 1) * 0.98)] || 1;
  }

  function makeCanvas(width, height, label) {
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    const canvas = el("canvas", { width: Math.round(width * dpr), height: Math.round(height * dpr), role: "img", "aria-label": label });
    canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;
    const g = canvas.getContext("2d");
    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    g.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    return { canvas, g };
  }

  /** A canvas with one pixel per cell. Draw it scaled with smoothing off. */
  function matrixImage(rows, cols, colorAt) {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = cols;
    c.height = rows;
    const g = c.getContext("2d");
    const img = g.createImageData(cols, rows);
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < cols; k++) {
        const rgb = colorAt(r, k);
        const i = (r * cols + k) * 4;
        img.data[i] = rgb[0];
        img.data[i + 1] = rgb[1];
        img.data[i + 2] = rgb[2];
        img.data[i + 3] = 255;
      }
    }
    g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    return c;
  }

  function hatch(g) {
    const p = document.createElement("canvas");
    p.width = 6;
    p.height = 6;
    const pg = p.getContext("2d");
    pg.fillStyle = colors.inset;
    pg.fillRect(0, 0, 6, 6);
    pg.strokeStyle = colors.rule;
    pg.lineWidth = 1;
    pg.beginPath();
    pg.moveTo(0, 6);
    pg.lineTo(6, 0);
    pg.stroke();
    return g.createPattern(p, "repeat");
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Tooltip
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const tip = el("div", { class: "tip", role: "status" });
  tip.hidden = true;
  document.body.append(tip);

  function showTip(lines, clientX, clientY) {
    tip.replaceChildren(...lines.map(([k, v]) => el("div", null, el("span", { class: "k" }, k + " "), v)));
    tip.hidden = false;
    const w = tip.offsetWidth;
    const h = tip.offsetHeight;
    let x = clientX + 14;
    let y = clientY + 16;
    if (x + w > window.innerWidth - 8) x = clientX - w - 14;
    if (y + h > window.innerHeight - 8) y = clientY - h - 14;
    tip.style.transform = `translate(${Math.max(4, x)}px, ${Math.max(4, y)}px)`;
  }

  function hover(canvas, hit, click) {
    canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
      const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const lines = hit(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
      if (lines) showTip(lines, e.clientX, e.clientY);
      else tip.hidden = true;
      canvas.style.cursor = lines && click ? "pointer" : "default";
    });
    canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { tip.hidden = true; });
    if (click) {
      canvas.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        click(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The run and its steps
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const REQUEST_TYPES = ["request", "template", "split", "bpe", "ids"];
  const PASS_TYPES = ["embed", "attn", "mlp", "head", "sample", "detok", "stop"];

  function buildSteps(run) {
    const steps = [];
    const add = (s) => steps.push(Object.assign({ index: steps.length }, s));
    for (const type of REQUEST_TYPES) add({ type });
    if (run.error) {
      add({ type: "error" });
      return steps;
    }
    run.passes.forEach((pass, p) => {
      add({ type: "embed", pass: p });
      for (let l = 0; l < L; l++) {
        add({ type: "attn", pass: p, layer: l });
        add({ type: "mlp", pass: p, layer: l });
      }
      for (const type of ["head", "sample", "detok", "stop"]) add({ type, pass: p });
    });
    add({ type: "finish" });
    return steps;
  }

  const stepKey = (type, pass, layer) => `${type}:${pass ?? ""}:${layer ?? ""}`;

  function stepTitle(s) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case "request": return "Request arrives";
      case "template": return "Chat template";
      case "split": return "Pre-tokenizer";
      case "bpe": return "BPE merges";
      case "ids": return "Token IDs";
      case "error": return "Prompt too long";
      case "embed": return "Embedding lookup";
      case "attn": return `Block ${s.layer + 1} · Attention`;
      case "mlp": return `Block ${s.layer + 1} · MLP`;
      case "head": return "Output head";
      case "sample": return "Sampler";
      case "detok": return "Detokenizer";
      case "stop": return "Stop check";
      case "finish": return "Response done";
      default: return s.type;
    }
  }

  /** The order of a stage inside the request: used for done / active / pending. */
  function stageOrder(type, layer) {
    switch (type) {
      case "request": return 0;
      case "template": return 1;
      case "split": case "bpe": case "ids": case "error": return 2;
      case "embed": return 10;
      case "attn": return 11 + 2 * layer;
      case "mlp": return 12 + 2 * layer;
      case "head": return 11 + 2 * L;
      case "sample": return 12 + 2 * L;
      case "detok": return 13 + 2 * L;
      case "stop": return 14 + 2 * L;
      case "finish": return 100;
      default: return -1;
    }
  }

  function runSimulation(keepPlace) {
    const previous = state.steps[state.index];
    state.run = E.simulate(model, state.message, state.settings);
    state.steps = buildSteps(state.run);
    state.stepIndex = new Map(state.steps.map((s) => [stepKey(s.type, s.pass, s.layer), s.index]));
    let index = 0;
    if (keepPlace && previous) {
      const same = state.stepIndex.get(stepKey(previous.type, previous.pass, previous.layer));
      index = same ?? Math.min(previous.index, state.steps.length - 1);
    }
    state.index = index;
    state.query = null;
    state.mlpPos = null;
    state.selected = null;
    syncPresets();
    render();
  }

  /** The request state at a step: tokens in the context, KV cache rows, client text. */
  function snapshot(step) {
    const run = state.run;
    const P = run.prompt.ids.length;
    const snap = { tokens: [], live: new Set(), fresh: -1, cache: new Array(L).fill(0), writeFrom: 0, writing: -1, text: "", freshText: "", freed: false, pass: null };
    if (["request", "template", "split", "bpe"].includes(step.type)) return snap;
    if (step.type === "ids" || step.type === "error") {
      snap.tokens = run.tokens.slice(0, P);
      return snap;
    }
    if (step.type === "finish") {
      snap.tokens = run.tokens.slice();
      snap.text = run.text;
      snap.freed = true;
      snap.cache.fill(run.passes[run.passes.length - 1].cacheLength);
      return snap;
    }
    const p = step.pass;
    const pass = run.passes[p];
    const before = p === 0 ? 0 : run.passes[p - 1].cacheLength;
    const after = pass.cacheLength;
    snap.pass = p;
    snap.tokens = run.tokens.slice(0, after);
    for (const rec of pass.positions) snap.live.add(rec.pos);
    const order = stageOrder(step.type, step.layer);
    for (let l = 0; l < L; l++) snap.cache[l] = order >= stageOrder("attn", l) ? after : before;
    snap.writeFrom = before;
    if (step.type === "attn") snap.writing = step.layer;
    if (["sample", "detok", "stop"].includes(step.type)) {
      snap.fresh = pass.tokenPos;
      snap.tokens = run.tokens.slice(0, after + 1);
    }
    snap.text = p === 0 ? "" : run.passes[p - 1].textAfter;
    if (step.type === "detok" || step.type === "stop") {
      const now = pass.textAfter;
      snap.freshText = now.startsWith(snap.text) ? now.slice(snap.text.length) : "";
      snap.text = now;
    }
    return snap;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Static parts: spec table, presets, settings, rail
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function renderSpec() {
    const rows = [
      ["Layers (blocks)", L, LLAMA.layers],
      ["Model dimension", D, LLAMA.dim],
      ["Query / KV heads", `${H} / ${cfg.n_kv_heads}`, `${LLAMA.heads} / ${LLAMA.kvHeads}`],
      ["Head dimension", model.headDim, LLAMA.headDim],
      ["MLP neurons per layer", cfg.hidden_dim, LLAMA.hidden],
      ["Vocabulary", V, LLAMA.vocab],
      ["Context window", cfg.max_seq_len, LLAMA.context],
      ["Parameters", model.parameterCount, "8.03 B"],
      ["KV cache per token", fmtBytes(TOY_KV), fmtBytes(LLAMA_KV)],
    ];
    const table = el("table", null,
      el("thead", null, el("tr", null, el("th", null, ""), el("th", null, "This model"), el("th", null, "Llama 3 8B"))),
      el("tbody", null, rows.map(([k, a, b]) => el("tr", null, el("td", null, k), el("td", null, typeof a === "number" ? fmtInt(a) : a), el("td", null, typeof b === "number" ? fmtInt(b) : b)))));
    $("#spec").replaceChildren(table);
  }

  function renderPresets() {
    $("#presets").replaceChildren(...PRESETS.map((p) =>
      el("button", { class: "preset", type: "button", "aria-pressed": "false", "data-text": p.text, onclick: () => setMessage(p.text) }, p.text, el("small", null, p.note))));
  }

  function syncPresets() {
    for (const b of document.querySelectorAll(".preset")) b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.text === state.message));
  }

  function setMessage(text) {
    pause();
    state.message = text;
    $("#msg").value = text;
    runSimulation(false);
  }

  const controls = {
    temperature: { el: "#temperature", out: "#temperature-out", get: (s) => s.temperature, set: (s, v) => { s.temperature = Number(v); }, show: (v) => (Number(v) === 0 ? "0 (greedy)" : Number(v).toFixed(2)) },
    topP: { el: "#top-p", out: "#top-p-out", get: (s) => s.topP, set: (s, v) => { s.topP = Number(v); }, show: (v) => (Number(v) >= 1 ? "1 (off)" : Number(v).toFixed(2)) },
    penalty: { el: "#penalty", out: "#penalty-out", get: (s) => s.repetitionPenalty, set: (s, v) => { s.repetitionPenalty = Number(v); }, show: (v) => (Number(v) === 1 ? "1 (off)" : Number(v).toFixed(2)) },
    topK: { el: "#top-k", get: (s) => s.topK, set: (s, v) => { s.topK = Math.max(0, Math.min(V, Math.round(Number(v) || 0))); } },
    maxTokens: { el: "#max-tokens", get: (s) => s.maxTokens, set: (s, v) => { s.maxTokens = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, Math.round(Number(v) || 1))); } },
    seed: { el: "#seed", get: (s) => s.seed, set: (s, v) => { s.seed = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(v) || 0)); } },
    stop: { el: "#stop-seq", get: (s) => s.stop[0] || "", set: (s, v) => { s.stop = v ? [v] : []; } },
  };

  function syncControls() {
    for (const c of Object.values(controls)) {
      const input = $(c.el);
      input.value = c.get(state.settings);
      if (c.out) $(c.out).textContent = c.show(input.value);
    }
  }

  let rerunTimer = 0;
  function bindControls() {
    for (const c of Object.values(controls)) {
      const input = $(c.el);
      const apply = () => {
        c.set(state.settings, input.value);
        if (c.out) $(c.out).textContent = c.show(input.value);
        clearTimeout(rerunTimer);
        rerunTimer = setTimeout(() => runSimulation(true), 120);
      };
      input.addEventListener(input.type === "range" ? "input" : "change", apply);
    }
    $("#new-seed").addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.settings.seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
      syncControls();
      runSimulation(true);
    });
    $("#reset-settings").addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.settings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, { stop: [] });
      syncControls();
      runSimulation(true);
    });
    $("#msg-form").addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const text = $("#msg").value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      setMessage(text);
    });
  }

  function buildRail() {
    const rail = $("#rail");
    const node = (id, label, onclick) => el("button", { class: "node", type: "button", "data-node": id, onclick }, el("span", null, label), el("span", { class: "shape" }));
    const blocks = [];
    for (let l = 0; l < L; l++) {
      blocks.push(el("div", { class: "blk", "data-node": `block${l}` },
        el("span", { class: "lbl" }, `Block ${l + 1}`),
        el("button", { class: "sub", type: "button", "data-sub": `attn${l}`, onclick: () => jumpTo("attn", l) }, "Attention"),
        el("button", { class: "sub", type: "button", "data-sub": `mlp${l}`, onclick: () => jumpTo("mlp", l) }, "MLP")));
    }
    rail.replaceChildren(
      el("div", { class: "rail-phase" }, el("div", { class: "big", id: "phase-big" }), el("div", { class: "small", id: "phase-small" })),
      el("div", { class: "rail-body" },
        el("div", { class: "rail-group label" }, "Request"),
        node("request", "API server", () => jumpTo("request")),
        node("template", "Chat template", () => jumpTo("template")),
        node("tokenizer", "Tokenizer", () => jumpTo("split")),
        el("div", { class: "rail-group label" }, "Generation loop"),
        el("div", { class: "loop-box", id: "loop-box" },
          node("embed", "Embedding", () => jumpTo("embed")),
          blocks,
          node("head", "Output head", () => jumpTo("head")),
          node("sample", "Sampler", () => jumpTo("sample")),
          node("detok", "Detokenizer", () => jumpTo("detok")),
          node("stop", "Stop check", () => jumpTo("stop")),
          el("div", { class: "loop-note" }, "↑ back to the embedding with the new token")),
        node("finish", "Response done", () => jumpTo("finish"))));
  }

  function jumpTo(type, layer) {
    const current = state.steps[state.index];
    let pass = PASS_TYPES.includes(type) ? current.pass ?? 0 : undefined;
    if (pass !== undefined && pass >= state.run.passes.length) pass = 0;
    const index = state.stepIndex.get(stepKey(type, pass, layer));
    if (index !== undefined) go(index);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Render: request state
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function renderState(step, snap) {
    const run = state.run;
    const box = $("#ctx-tokens");
    box.replaceChildren();
    if (!snap.tokens.length) {
      box.append(el("div", { class: "empty-note" }, "The context is empty. The tokenizer fills it with the prompt tokens."));
    }
    const selected = selectedToken(snap);
    for (const t of snap.tokens) {
      const cls = [];
      if (snap.live.has(t.pos)) cls.push("is-live");
      if (t.pos === snap.fresh) cls.push("is-new");
      if (t.pos === selected) cls.push("is-selected");
      const c = chip(t.id, { origin: t.origin, button: true, cls: cls.join(" "), title: `Position ${t.pos}. Select to follow this token.` });
      c.addEventListener("click", () => { state.selected = t.pos; render(); });
      box.append(c);
    }
    const prompt = Math.min(snap.tokens.length, run.prompt.ids.length);
    const generated = snap.tokens.length - prompt;
    $("#ctx-meta").textContent = snap.tokens.length
      ? `${snap.tokens.length} of ${cfg.max_seq_len} positions · ${prompt} prompt${generated ? ` + ${generated} new` : ""}`
      : `0 of ${cfg.max_seq_len} positions`;

    renderKv(snap);

    const stream = $("#stream");
    stream.replaceChildren();
    const finished = step.type === "finish";
    if (!snap.text && !finished) stream.append(el("span", { class: "placeholder" }, step.pass == null ? "Nothing yet. Text arrives after the first sample." : "Waiting for the first token…"));
    else {
      stream.append(snap.text.slice(0, snap.text.length - snap.freshText.length));
      if (snap.freshText) stream.append(el("span", { class: "fresh" }, snap.freshText));
    }
    if (!finished && step.pass != null) stream.append(el("span", { class: "caret", "aria-hidden": "true" }));
    $("#stream-meta").textContent = finished ? `finish_reason "${run.finish.reason}"` : snap.text ? `${snap.text.length} characters` : "";
  }

  function renderKv(snap) {
    const host = $("#kv-grid");
    const width = Math.max(200, host.clientWidth || 300);
    const labelW = 24;
    const cols = cfg.max_seq_len;
    const cellW = (width - labelW) / cols;
    const rowH = 9;
    const gap = 3;
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(width, L * (rowH + gap), "KV cache: one row per layer, one cell per position");
    g.font = `10px ${MONO}`;
    g.textBaseline = "middle";
    for (let l = 0; l < L; l++) {
      const y = l * (rowH + gap);
      g.fillStyle = colors["ink-2"];
      g.fillText(`L${l + 1}`, 0, y + rowH / 2 + 0.5);
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        let fill = colors.inset;
        if (c < snap.cache[l]) {
          if (snap.freed) fill = colors.rule;
          else if (l === snap.writing && c >= snap.writeFrom) fill = colors.focus;
          else fill = alpha("focus", 0.42);
        }
        g.fillStyle = fill;
        g.fillRect(labelW + c * cellW, y, Math.max(1, cellW - 1), rowH);
      }
    }
    host.replaceChildren(canvas);
    const n = Math.max(...snap.cache);
    $("#kv-meta").textContent = snap.freed
      ? `freed · held ${n} positions`
      : `${n} positions · ${fmtBytes(n * TOY_KV)} · Llama 3 8B: ${fmtBytes(n * LLAMA_KV)}`;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Render: rail
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function renderRail(step) {
    const run = state.run;
    const order = stageOrder(step.type, step.layer);
    const inPass = step.pass != null;
    const set = (node, nodeOrder, active) => {
      node.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
      node.classList.toggle("is-done", !active && (step.type === "finish" || (inPass && nodeOrder < 10) || nodeOrder < order));
    };
    const shape = (id, text) => { const s = document.querySelector(`[data-node="${id}"] .shape`); if (s) s.textContent = text || ""; };

    set(document.querySelector('[data-node="request"]'), 0, step.type === "request");
    set(document.querySelector('[data-node="template"]'), 1, step.type === "template");
    set(document.querySelector('[data-node="tokenizer"]'), 2, ["split", "bpe", "ids", "error"].includes(step.type));
    for (const id of ["embed", "head", "sample", "detok", "stop"]) set(document.querySelector(`[data-node="${id}"]`), stageOrder(id), step.type === id);
    for (let l = 0; l < L; l++) {
      for (const kind of ["attn", "mlp"]) {
        const b = document.querySelector(`[data-sub="${kind}${l}"]`);
        const o = stageOrder(kind, l);
        b.classList.toggle("is-active", step.type === kind && step.layer === l);
        b.classList.toggle("is-done", !(step.type === kind && step.layer === l) && (step.type === "finish" || (inPass && o < order)));
      }
      document.querySelector(`[data-node="block${l}"] .lbl`).classList.toggle("is-done", step.type === "finish" || (inPass && stageOrder("mlp", l) < order));
    }
    set(document.querySelector('[data-node="finish"]'), 100, step.type === "finish");

    const P = run.prompt.ids.length;
    shape("request", "");
    shape("tokenizer", stageOrder(step.type) >= 2 ? `${P} tokens` : "text → IDs");
    const pass = inPass ? run.passes[step.pass] : null;
    shape("embed", pass ? `[${pass.positions.length} × ${D}]` : `[n × ${D}]`);
    shape("head", `${D} → ${V}`);
    shape("sample", pass && order >= stageOrder("sample") ? plainLabel(pass.token) : "");
    shape("detok", pass && order >= stageOrder("detok") ? (pass.emitted.special ? "(none)" : JSON.stringify(pass.emitted.text)) : "");
    shape("stop", pass && order >= stageOrder("stop") ? (pass.finish ? "stop" : "continue") : "");
    shape("finish", run.finish ? `"${run.finish.reason}"` : "");

    $("#loop-box").classList.toggle("is-looping", step.type === "stop" && !pass.finish);

    let big;
    let small;
    if (!inPass && step.type !== "finish") {
      big = "Before the model";
      small = run.error ? "The prompt does not fit." : "The server prepares the input.";
    } else if (step.type === "finish") {
      big = "Done";
      small = `${run.passes.length} forward passes · finish_reason "${run.finish.reason}"`;
    } else {
      big = pass.kind === "prefill" ? "Prefill" : `Decode step ${step.pass}`;
      small = `Forward pass ${step.pass + 1} of ${run.passes.length} · ${pass.positions.length === 1 ? `1 position in (#${pass.positions[0].pos})` : `${pass.positions.length} positions in`}`;
    }
    $("#phase-big").textContent = big;
    $("#phase-small").textContent = small;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Render: scope (one view per stage)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function scopeWidth() {
    const scope = $("#scope");
    const style = getComputedStyle(scope);
    return Math.max(280, scope.clientWidth - parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) - parseFloat(style.paddingRight));
  }

  function eyebrow(step) {
    const run = state.run;
    if (step.pass == null) return step.type === "finish" ? "After the last forward pass" : "Before the model runs";
    const pass = run.passes[step.pass];
    return pass.kind === "prefill"
      ? `Prefill · forward pass 1 of ${run.passes.length} · positions 0–${pass.positions.length - 1}`
      : `Decode · forward pass ${step.pass + 1} of ${run.passes.length} · position ${pass.positions[0].pos}`;
  }

  function renderScope(step) {
    const view = VIEWS[step.type](step);
    const scope = $("#scope");
    const head = el("div", { class: "scope-head" },
      el("div", { class: "eyebrow" }, el("span", { class: "label" }, eyebrow(step)), (view.docs || []).map(docLink)),
      el("h2", { id: "scope-title" }, view.title || stepTitle(step)),
      (view.explain || []).map((p) => el("p", { class: "explain" }, p)));
    const fig = el("div", { class: "fig" }, view.figure || []);
    const scale = view.scale && view.scale.length
      ? el("div", { class: "scale" }, el("div", { class: "label" }, "At Llama 3 8B scale"), view.scale.map((line) => el("div", null, line)))
      : null;
    scope.replaceChildren(head, fig, scale || []);
  }

  function lensRow(dist, caption) {
    const top = E.topIndices(dist, 4);
    return el("div", null,
      figLabel("Logit lens", caption),
      el("div", { class: "lens" }, top.map((id) => el("span", null, chip(id, { noId: true, cls: "small" }), el("span", { class: "p" }, fmtPct(dist[id]))))));
  }

  const VIEWS = {
    request() {
      const run = state.run;
      const s = run.settings;
      const body = { model: "toy-llama", messages: [{ role: "user", content: run.userText }], stream: true, temperature: s.temperature, top_p: s.topP };
      if (s.topK) body.top_k = s.topK;
      if (s.repetitionPenalty !== 1) body.repetition_penalty = s.repetitionPenalty;
      body.max_tokens = s.maxTokens;
      body.seed = s.seed;
      if (s.stop.length) body.stop = s.stop;
      const P = run.prompt.ids.length;
      const n = run.passes.length;
      const item = (k, v) => el("li", null, el("span", { class: "k" }, k), el("span", { class: "v" }, v));
      const glance = run.error
        ? el("div", { class: "callout" }, run.error)
        : el("ol", { class: "glance" },
          item("Template and tokenizer", `${P} prompt tokens`),
          item("Prefill", `1 forward pass over ${P} positions`),
          item("Decode", `${n - 1} forward pass${n - 1 === 1 ? "" : "es"}, 1 position each`),
          item("Finish", `${n} new tokens · finish_reason "${run.finish.reason}"`));
      return {
        docs: ["00", "08"],
        explain: [
          "The client sends the whole conversation and the sampler settings in one HTTP request. The model keeps no memory between requests, so the request carries all of the state.",
          "The API server applies the chat template and the tokenizer. Then the scheduler gives the request to the model, one forward pass at a time.",
        ],
        figure: [
          el("div", null, figLabel("HTTP request", "OpenAI-compatible chat API"), el("pre", { class: "code" }, "POST /v1/chat/completions\n\n" + JSON.stringify(body, null, 2))),
          el("div", null, figLabel("This run at a glance"), glance),
        ],
        scale: [
          el("span", null, "Llama 3 8B Instruct ships with ", el("b", null, "temperature 0.6"), " and ", el("b", null, "top_p 0.9"), " in its generation_config.json. This page starts with the same values."),
        ],
      };
    },

    template() {
      const run = state.run;
      const tape = el("div", { class: "tape" }, run.prompt.segments.map((seg) =>
        seg.kind === "special"
          ? el("span", { class: "chip is-special" }, seg.text)
          : el("span", { class: `seg-text${seg.kind === "content" ? " is-content" : ""}` }, visibleText(seg.text))));
      const legend = el("div", { class: "legend" },
        el("span", null, el("span", { class: "chip is-special small" }, "<|…|>"), "special token, added by ID"),
        el("span", null, el("span", { class: "swatch", style: { background: "var(--inset)", border: "1px solid var(--rule)" } }), "role name or separator"),
        el("span", null, el("span", { class: "swatch", style: { background: "var(--prompt-bg)" } }), "the user's message"));
      const injected = Object.keys(tok.special).filter((name) => run.userText.includes(name));
      return {
        docs: ["01"],
        explain: [
          "The chat template wraps the message in special tokens. They mark who speaks and where each turn ends.",
          "The template ends with an open assistant header. So the next token that the model writes is the first token of the reply.",
        ],
        figure: [
          el("div", null, figLabel("Llama 3 chat format", "↵ is a newline"), tape),
          legend,
          injected.length
            ? el("div", { class: "callout is-focus" }, `Your message contains the text ${injected.join(", ")}. The tokenizer encodes it as plain text, not as a control token, so a user cannot end the turn early.`)
            : el("div", { class: "callout" }, "The template inserts special tokens by ID. If a user types \"<|eot_id|>\", the tokenizer encodes that text as plain characters, so a user cannot inject a control token."),
        ],
        scale: [
          el("span", null, "Llama 3 uses this exact format. Its special tokens are ", el("b", null, "<|begin_of_text|> 128000, <|start_header_id|> 128006, <|end_header_id|> 128007, <|eot_id|> 128009"), `. In this toy model they are ${tok.special["<|begin_of_text|>"]}–${tok.special["<|eot_id|>"]}.`),
        ],
      };
    },

    split() {
      const run = state.run;
      const rows = el("div", { class: "split-rows" }, run.prompt.segments.map((seg) => {
        if (seg.kind === "special") {
          return el("div", { class: "split-row" }, el("span", { class: "split-kind" }, "special"),

          el("div", null, figLabel("Cost of this request", "both models at 2 bytes per number"), el("div", { class: "table-wrap" }, cost)),
        ],
        scale: [el("span", null, "Decode is memory-bound: each pass reads every weight once. A server batches many requests, so one read of the weights serves many tokens.")],
      };
    },
  };

  function checkDetail(c, pass, run) {
    if (c.id === "stop-token") return `${tok.label(pass.token)}${c.passed ? " is a stop token" : " is not <|eot_id|> or <|end_of_text|>"}`;
    if (c.id === "stop-sequence") return run.settings.stop.length ? (c.passed ? `the text ends with ${JSON.stringify(c.detail)}` : `no ${JSON.stringify(run.settings.stop[0])} in the new text`) : "none set";
    return c.detail;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Figures
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function bpeCard(trace) {
    const byteCount = trace.steps[0].ids.length;
    const rows = trace.steps.map((st, i) => {
      const merged = st.merge ? st.merge.id : -1;
      return el("div", { class: "bpe-row" },
        st.ids.map((id) => el("span", { class: `bpe-tile${i === 0 ? " is-byte" : ""}${id === merged ? " is-merged" : ""}` }, i === 0 ? byteGlyph(id) : tokenGlyphs(id))),
        el("span", { class: "bpe-rule" }, i === 0 ? "bytes" : `rule #${st.merge.rank}`));
    });
    return el("div", { class: "bpe-card" },
      el("div", { class: "bpe-title" }, el("span", null, visibleText(trace.text)), el("span", { class: "muted" }, `${byteCount} B → ${trace.ids.length} token${trace.ids.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`)),
      rows,
      el("div", { class: "bpe-row" }, trace.ids.map((id) => el("span", { class: "chip is-prompt small" }, el("span", { class: "t" }, tokenGlyphs(id)), el("span", { class: "id" }, id)))));
  }

  function byteGlyph(b) {
    if (b === 0x20) return el("span", { class: "ws" }, "·");
    if (b === 0x0a) return el("span", { class: "ws" }, "↵");
    if (b > 0x20 && b < 0x7f) return String.fromCharCode(b);
    return b.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, "0");
  }

  function embeddingImage() {
    if (!imageCache.has("embedding")) {
      const scale = robustScale(model.embedding);
      imageCache.set("embedding-scale", scale);
      imageCache.set("embedding", matrixImage(V, D, (r, c) => diverging(model.embedding[r * D + c], scale)));
    }
    return imageCache.get("embedding");
  }

  function embedFigure(pass) {
    const recs = pass.positions;
    const n = recs.length;
    const width = scopeWidth();
    const narrow = width < 560;
    const tableW = narrow ? 64 : 104;
    const gapW = narrow ? 40 : 96;
    const labelW = narrow ? 92 : 132;
    const rowH = n === 1 ? 24 : Math.max(11, Math.min(18, Math.floor(320 / n)));
    const rowsH = rowH * n;
    const tableH = Math.max(230, Math.min(330, rowsH));
    const top = 20;
    const height = top + Math.max(tableH, rowsH) + 6;
    const rowsX = tableW + gapW + labelW;
    const cellW = Math.max(2, Math.floor(((width - rowsX) / D) * 10) / 10);
    const totalW = Math.ceil(rowsX + cellW * D);
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(totalW, height, `Embedding lookup of ${n} token(s)`);
    const img = embeddingImage();
    const scale = imageCache.get("embedding-scale");
    g.drawImage(img, 0, top, tableW, tableH);
    g.strokeStyle = colors.rule;
    g.strokeRect(0.5, top + 0.5, tableW - 1, tableH - 1);
    g.font = `10.5px ${MONO}`;
    g.fillStyle = colors["ink-2"];
    g.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    g.fillText(`table [${V} × ${D}]`, 0, 12);
    g.fillText(`residual stream [${n} × ${D}]`, rowsX, 12);
    const rowsTop = top + Math.max(0, (tableH - rowsH) / 2);
    g.textBaseline = "middle";
    g.font = `${Math.min(12, rowH - 1)}px ${MONO}`;
    recs.forEach((rec, i) => {
      const y = rowsTop + i * rowH;
      const ty = top + ((rec.tokenId + 0.5) / V) * tableH;
      g.strokeStyle = colors.focus;
      g.lineWidth = 1.5;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(0, ty);
      g.lineTo(tableW, ty);
      g.stroke();
      g.strokeStyle = alpha("focus", 0.45);
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(tableW + 2, ty);
      g.bezierCurveTo(tableW + gapW * 0.55, ty, tableW + gapW * 0.45, y + rowH / 2, tableW + gapW - 2, y + rowH / 2);
      g.stroke();
      for (let d = 0; d < D; d++) {
        g.fillStyle = css(diverging(rec.embedding[d], scale));
        g.fillRect(rowsX + d * cellW, y, Math.ceil(cellW), rowH - 1);
      }
      g.fillStyle = colors.ink;
      let label = `${plainLabel(rec.tokenId)}`;
      const idText = ` ${rec.tokenId}`;
      while (label.length > 2 && g.measureText(label + idText).width > labelW - 10) label = label.slice(0, -2) + "…";
      g.fillText(label, tableW + gapW + 4, y + rowH / 2);
      g.fillStyle = colors["ink-2"];
      g.fillText(idText, tableW + gapW + 4 + g.measureText(label).width, y + rowH / 2);
    });
    hover(canvas, (x, y) => {
      if (x >= rowsX && y >= rowsTop && y < rowsTop + rowsH) {
        const i = Math.floor((y - rowsTop) / rowH);
        const d = Math.min(D - 1, Math.floor((x - rowsX) / cellW));
        const rec = recs[i];
        if (!rec) return null;
        return [["position", String(rec.pos)], ["token", `${plainLabel(rec.tokenId)} (row ${rec.tokenId})`], ["dimension", String(d)], ["value", rec.embedding[d].toFixed(4)]];
      }
      if (x < tableW && y >= top && y < top + tableH) {
        const r = Math.min(V - 1, Math.floor(((y - top) / tableH) * V));
        return [["row", String(r)], ["token", plainLabel(r)]];
      }
      return null;
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function headPicker(pass, l, prefill) {
    const recs = pass.positions;
    const groups = [];
    for (let kv = 0; kv < cfg.n_kv_heads; kv++) {
      const buttons = [];
      for (let h = kv * GROUP; h < (kv + 1) * GROUP; h++) {
        const size = 56;
        const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(size, prefill ? size : 18, `Head ${h + 1} thumbnail`);
        if (prefill) {
          const n = recs.length;
          const img = matrixImage(n, n, (i, j) => (j <= i ? ramp(recs[i].layers[l].weights[h][j]) : colors["inset:rgb"]));
          g.drawImage(img, 0, 0, size, size);
        } else {
          const w = recs[0].layers[l].weights[h];
          const img = matrixImage(1, w.length, (i, j) => ramp(w[j]));
          g.drawImage(img, 0, 0, size, 18);
        }
        g.strokeStyle = colors.rule;
        g.strokeRect(0.5, 0.5, size - 1, (prefill ? size : 18) - 1);
        buttons.push(el("button", { class: "headbtn", type: "button", "aria-pressed": String(state.head === h), onclick: () => { state.head = h; render(); } }, canvas, `Head ${h + 1}`));
      }
      groups.push(el("div", { class: "kvgroup" }, el("span", { class: "label" }, `Key/value head ${kv + 1}`), el("div", { class: "kvgroup-heads" }, buttons)));
    }
    return el("div", { class: "heads" }, groups);
  }

  function attnMatrix(recs, l, h, qPos, width) {
    const n = recs.length;
    const labelW = Math.min(132, Math.max(76, Math.floor(width * 0.18)));
    const cell = Math.max(5, Math.min(24, Math.floor((width - labelW - 10) / n)));
    const size = cell * n;
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(labelW + size + 2, size + 2, `Attention weights of head ${h + 1}`);
    const pattern = hatch(g);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        if (j <= i) g.fillStyle = css(ramp(recs[i].layers[l].weights[h][j]));
        else g.fillStyle = pattern;
        g.fillRect(labelW + j * cell, i * cell, cell - (cell > 8 ? 1 : 0), cell - (cell > 8 ? 1 : 0));
      }
    }
    if (cell >= 9) {
      g.font = `${Math.min(12, cell - 2)}px ${MONO}`;
      g.textBaseline = "middle";
      g.textAlign = "right";
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        let label = plainLabel(recs[i].tokenId);
        while (label.length > 2 && g.measureText(label).width > labelW - 12) label = label.slice(0, -2) + "…";
        g.fillStyle = recs[i].pos === qPos ? colors.focus : colors["ink-2"];
        g.fillText(label, labelW - 6, i * cell + cell / 2);
      }
      g.textAlign = "left";
    }
    const qi = recs.findIndex((r) => r.pos === qPos);
    if (qi >= 0) {
      g.strokeStyle = colors.ink;
      g.lineWidth = 1.5;
      g.strokeRect(labelW + 0.75, qi * cell + 0.75, (qi + 1) * cell - 1.5, cell - 1.5);
    }
    const at = (x, y) => {
      if (x < labelW) return null;
      const i = Math.floor(y / cell);
      const j = Math.floor((x - labelW) / cell);
      if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n) return null;
      return [i, j];
    };
    hover(canvas, (x, y) => {
      const ij = at(x, y);
      if (!ij) return null;
      const [i, j] = ij;
      const q = recs[i];
      const k = recs[j];
      if (j > i) return [["query", `${plainLabel(q.tokenId)} @${q.pos}`], ["key", `${plainLabel(k.tokenId)} @${k.pos}`], ["masked", "a later position"]];
      return [["query", `${plainLabel(q.tokenId)} @${q.pos}`], ["key", `${plainLabel(k.tokenId)} @${k.pos}`], ["weight", fmtProb(q.layers[l].weights[h][j])], ["score", fmtNum(q.layers[l].scores[h][j], 3)]];
    }, (x, y) => {
      const i = Math.floor(y / cell);
      if (i >= 0 && i < n) { state.query = recs[i].pos; render(); }
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function ribbon(weights) {
    const run = state.run;
    return el("div", { class: "ribbon" }, Array.from(weights, (w, j) => {
      const t = run.tokens[j];
      const c = chip(t.id, { origin: t.origin, sub: fmtPct(w), title: `Position ${j}: weight ${fmtProb(w)}` });
      c.style.background = css(ramp(w));
      c.style.color = w > 0.45 ? colors["focus-ink"] : colors.ink;
      return c;
    }));
  }

  function neuronStrip(recs, l, pos, scale, width) {
    const n = recs.length;
    const labelW = Math.min(120, Math.max(70, Math.floor(width * 0.16)));
    const cellW = Math.max(1.5, Math.floor(((width - labelW) / cfg.hidden_dim) * 10) / 10);
    const rowH = Math.max(7, Math.min(14, Math.floor(260 / n)));
    const totalW = Math.ceil(labelW + cellW * cfg.hidden_dim);
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(totalW, n * rowH, "MLP activations for every position");
    const img = matrixImage(n, cfg.hidden_dim, (i, j) => diverging(recs[i].layers[l].act[j], scale));
    g.drawImage(img, labelW, 0, cellW * cfg.hidden_dim, n * rowH);
    g.font = `${Math.min(11, rowH - 1)}px ${MONO}`;
    g.textBaseline = "middle";
    g.textAlign = "right";
    recs.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (rowH < 9 && r.pos !== pos && i % 2) return;
      let label = plainLabel(r.tokenId);
      while (label.length > 2 && g.measureText(label).width > labelW - 10) label = label.slice(0, -2) + "…";
      g.fillStyle = r.pos === pos ? colors.focus : colors["ink-2"];
      g.fillText(label, labelW - 6, i * rowH + rowH / 2);
    });
    const si = recs.findIndex((r) => r.pos === pos);
    g.strokeStyle = colors.ink;
    g.lineWidth = 1.5;
    g.strokeRect(labelW + 0.75, si * rowH + 0.75, cellW * cfg.hidden_dim - 1.5, rowH - 1.5);
    const effects = model.neuronEffects(l);
    hover(canvas, (x, y) => {
      const i = Math.floor(y / rowH);
      const j = Math.floor((x - labelW) / cellW);
      if (x < labelW || i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= cfg.hidden_dim) return null;
      const a = recs[i].layers[l].act[j];
      return [["position", `${recs[i].pos} ${plainLabel(recs[i].tokenId)}`], ["neuron", `#${j}`], ["activation", fmtNum(a, 3)], ["raises", (a >= 0 ? effects[j].promotes : effects[j].suppresses).map(plainLabel).join("  ")]];
    }, (x, y) => {
      const i = Math.floor(y / rowH);
      if (i >= 0 && i < n) { state.mlpPos = recs[i].pos; render(); }
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function neuronGrid(act, scale, effects) {
    const cols = 16;
    const rows = Math.ceil(act.length / cols);
    const cell = 17;
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(cols * cell, rows * cell, "MLP neuron activations");
    for (let n = 0; n < act.length; n++) {
      g.fillStyle = css(diverging(act[n], scale));
      g.fillRect((n % cols) * cell, Math.floor(n / cols) * cell, cell - 1, cell - 1);
    }
    hover(canvas, (x, y) => {
      const n = Math.floor(y / cell) * cols + Math.floor(x / cell);
      if (n < 0 || n >= act.length) return null;
      return [["neuron", `#${n}`], ["activation", fmtNum(act[n], 3)], ["raises", (act[n] >= 0 ? effects[n].promotes : effects[n].suppresses).map(plainLabel).join("  ")]];
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function logitLandscape(logits, width) {
    const height = 150;
    const top = 22;
    const bottom = 14;
    const W = Math.max(300, Math.floor(width));
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(W, height, `All ${V} logits`);
    let min = Infinity;
    let max = -Infinity;
    for (const v of logits) { if (v < min) min = v; if (v > max) max = v; }
    const y = (v) => top + ((max - v) / (max - min || 1)) * (height - top - bottom);
    const y0 = y(Math.max(min, Math.min(max, 0)));
    const bw = W / V;
    g.strokeStyle = colors.rule;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(0, y0 + 0.5);
    g.lineTo(W, y0 + 0.5);
    g.stroke();
    const top3 = new Set(E.topIndices(logits, 3));
    for (let i = 0; i < V; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = top3.has(i) ? colors.focus : alpha("ink-2", 0.55);
      const yy = y(logits[i]);
      g.fillRect(i * bw, Math.min(yy, y0), Math.max(1, bw), Math.max(1, Math.abs(y0 - yy)));
    }
    g.font = `11px ${MONO}`;
    g.fillStyle = colors.ink;
    g.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    for (const i of top3) {
      const label = plainLabel(i);
      const tw = g.measureText(label).width;
      const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - tw, i * bw - tw / 2));
      g.fillText(label, x, Math.max(11, y(logits[i]) - 5));
    }
    g.fillStyle = colors["ink-2"];
    g.font = `10px ${MONO}`;
    g.fillText(`max ${fmtNum(max)}`, W - 70, height - 2);
    g.fillText("ID 0", 0, height - 2);
    hover(canvas, (x) => {
      const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(V - 1, Math.floor(x / bw)));
      return [["ID", String(i)], ["token", plainLabel(i)], ["logit", fmtNum(logits[i], 3)]];
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function drawBar(d, width) {
    const W = Math.max(280, Math.floor(width));
    const height = 46;
    const { canvas, g } = makeCanvas(W, height, "The random draw over the final probabilities");
    const order = d.greedy ? [d.chosen] : d.order.filter((id) => d.probs[id] > 0);
    const segs = [];
    let x = 0;
    for (const id of order) {
      const w = (d.greedy ? 1 : d.probs[id]) * W;
      segs.push({ id, x, w });
      x += w;
    }
    segs.forEach((s, i) => {
      g.fillStyle = s.id === d.chosen ? colors.focus : i % 2 ? alpha("focus", 0.22) : alpha("focus", 0.36);
      g.fillRect(s.x, 8, Math.max(1, s.w - 1), 24);
      if (s.w > 34) {
        g.fillStyle = s.id === d.chosen ? colors["focus-ink"] : colors.ink;
        g.font = `11px ${MONO}`;
        g.textBaseline = "middle";
        let label = plainLabel(s.id);
        while (label.length > 1 && g.measureText(label).width > s.w - 8) label = label.slice(0, -1);
        g.fillText(label, s.x + 4, 20);
      }
    });
    if (!d.greedy) {
      const ux = d.u * W;
      g.fillStyle = colors.ink;
      g.fillRect(ux - 1, 2, 2, 34);
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(ux - 5, 0);
      g.lineTo(ux + 5, 0);
      g.lineTo(ux, 6);
      g.fill();
      g.font = `10px ${MONO}`;
      g.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
      const label = `u = ${d.u.toFixed(3)}`;
      const tw = g.measureText(label).width;
      g.fillText(label, Math.max(0, Math.min(W - tw, ux - tw / 2)), height - 1);
    }
    hover(canvas, (mx) => {
      const s = segs.find((seg) => mx >= seg.x && mx < seg.x + seg.w);
      if (!s) return null;
      return [["token", plainLabel(s.id)], ["probability", fmtProb(d.greedy ? 1 : d.probs[s.id])], ["covers", d.greedy ? "0 to 1" : `${(s.x / W).toFixed(3)} to ${((s.x + s.w) / W).toFixed(3)}`]];
    });
    return canvas;
  }

  function stopSpark(upto) {
    const run = state.run;
    return el("div", { class: "spark" }, run.passes.slice(0, upto + 1).map((p, i) => {
      const v = p.draw.modelProbs[EOT];
      return el("div", { class: `col${i === upto ? " is-current" : ""}`, title: `Pass ${i + 1}: chose ${tok.label(p.token)}, P(<|eot_id|>) = ${fmtProb(v)}` },
        el("div", { class: "pv" }, v >= 0.005 ? fmtPct(v) : ""),
        el("div", { class: "barbox" }, el("div", { class: "bar", style: { height: `${Math.max(v > 0.005 ? 2 : 0, v * 100)}%` } })),
        chip(p.token, { origin: "generated", noId: true, cls: "small" }));
    }));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Render: token lifecycle
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function selectedToken(snap) {
    if (state.selected != null && state.selected < snap.tokens.length) return state.selected;
    if (snap.fresh >= 0) return snap.fresh;
    if (snap.live.size) return Math.max(...snap.live);
    return snap.tokens.length ? snap.tokens[snap.tokens.length - 1].pos : null;
  }

  function renderLifecycle(step, snap) {
    const host = $("#lifecycle");
    const run = state.run;
    const pos = selectedToken(snap);
    if (pos == null) {
      host.replaceChildren(
        el("div", { class: "life-head" }, el("h3", null, "Token lifecycle")),
        el("p", { class: "muted", style: { margin: 0 } }, "Tokens appear after the tokenizer step. Then select any token in the context window to follow it from birth to the end of the request."));
      return;
    }
    const t = run.tokens[pos];
    const now = state.index;
    const at = (type, pass, layer) => state.stepIndex.get(stepKey(type, pass, layer));
    const events = [];
    const generated = t.origin === "generated";
    const fedPass = generated ? (t.fed ? t.pass + 1 : null) : 0;

    if (!generated) {
      const seg = run.prompt.segments[t.segment];
      events.push({ when: "Tokenizer", what: "Born from text", detail: seg.kind === "special" ? `The chat template added ${tok.label(t.id)} by ID.` : `BPE made it from the ${seg.kind === "content" ? "message" : "template"} text.`, step: at("ids") });
    } else {
      const d = run.passes[t.pass].draw;
      const rank = Array.from(d.raw).filter((v) => v > d.raw[t.id]).length + 1;
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${t.pass + 1} · sampler`, what: "Born from a draw", detail: `p = ${fmtProb(d.probs[t.id])} after the sampler (model: ${fmtProb(d.modelProbs[t.id])}, rank ${rank} of ${V}).`, step: at("sample", t.pass) });
      const em = run.passes[t.pass].emitted;
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${t.pass + 1} · detokenizer`, what: em.special ? "Not shown" : "Streamed", detail: em.special ? "A special token sends no text to the client." : `The client gets ${JSON.stringify(em.text)}.`, step: at("detok", t.pass) });
    }
    if (fedPass != null) {
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${fedPass + 1} · embedding`, what: "Fed back as input", detail: `Row ${t.id} of the table becomes the vector at position ${pos}.`, step: at("embed", fedPass) });
      events.push({ when: `Pass ${fedPass + 1} · attention`, what: "Written to the KV cache", detail: `Its keys and values enter layers 1–${L}: ${fmtBytes(TOY_KV)} here, ${fmtBytes(LLAMA_KV)} in Llama 3 8B.`, step: at("attn", fedPass, 0) });
      const lastPass = run.passes.length - 1;
      const reads = fedPass === lastPass ? 0 : lastPass - fedPass;
      events.push({ when: "Later passes", what: "Read by new tokens", detail: reads ? `${reads} later token${reads === 1 ? "" : "s"} attend to it. The grid shows how much.` : "No later token reads it.", step: reads ? at("attn", fedPass + 1, 0) : at("finish") });
      events.push({ when: "Request end", what: "Freed", detail: "The server frees the KV cache, unless it keeps it for prefix caching.", step: at("finish") });
    } else {
      events.push({ when: "Stop check", what: "Never fed back", detail: "The runtime stopped, so this token never enters the model.", step: at("stop", t.pass) });
    }

    let nowMarked = false;
    const items = events.map((ev, i) => {
      const next = events[i + 1];
      const isNow = !nowMarked && ev.step <= now && (!next || next.step > now);
      if (isNow) nowMarked = true;
      return el("li", { class: `ev${ev.step > now ? " is-pending" : ""}${isNow ? " is-now" : ""}` },
        el("span", { class: "when" }, ev.when), el("span", { class: "what" }, ev.what), el("span", { class: "detail" }, ev.detail));
    });

    const head = el("div", { class: "life-head" },
      el("h3", null, "Life of", chip(t.id, { origin: t.origin }), el("span", { class: "muted", style: { fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 400 } }, `position ${pos} · ${generated ? "generated" : "prompt"}`)),
      state.selected != null ? el("button", { class: "follow", type: "button", onclick: () => { state.selected = null; render(); } }, "Follow the current token") : el("span", { class: "muted", style: { fontSize: "12px" } }, "Select any token in the context window."));

    host.replaceChildren(head, el("ol", { class: "life-events" }, items), fedPass != null ? readGrid(pos, fedPass, step) : null);
  }

  function readGrid(pos, fedPass, step) {
    const run = state.run;
    const passes = [];
    for (let p = fedPass; p < run.passes.length; p++) passes.push(p);

.flow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }

.verdict.is-go { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 12%, var(--panel)); color: var(--ok); }
.verdict.is-halt { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--halt) 12%, var(--panel)); color: var(--halt); }
.verdict .mono { font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink); }
.spark { display: flex; gap: 3px; align-items: flex-end; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 2px; }
.spark .col { display: grid; gap: 4px; justify-items: center; flex: none; }
.spark .barbox { width: 22px; height: 64px; background: var(--inset); border-radius: 3px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; overflow: hidden; }
.spark .bar { width: 100%; background: var(--halt); }
.spark .col.is-current .barbox { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus); }

/* Lifecycle */
.lifecycle { padding: 16px 20px 18px; }
.life-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; }

.life-events { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(175px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; counter-reset: ev; }
.ev { counter-increment: ev; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px 9px; display: grid; gap: 2px; align-content: start; }
.ev .when { font: 500 10.5px/1.2 var(--font-data); color: var(--ink-2); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }

.ev .what { font-weight: 650; }
.ev .detail { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.ev.is-pending { opacity: .5; border-style: dashed; }

.transport {

.scrub-wrap { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.scrub-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font: 500 12px/1.2 var(--font-data); white-space: nowrap; min-width: 0; }
.scrub-label span:first-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

.segm {

.playhead { position: absolute; top: -4px; bottom: -4px; width: 3px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--focus); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; }
.tside { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

.tip {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--panel);

<div class="page">
  <header class="masthead">
    <div class="brand">
      <div class="kicker label"><span>Interactive simulation</span><span>LLM internals, documents 00–08</span></div>
      <h1>Life of a Token<span class="tick">.</span></h1>
      <p>Follow one chat request through a small Llama-style transformer that runs in this page. The tokenizer, the four blocks, the sampler, and the stop check all run live, so every number on the page comes from the model.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="spec" id="spec"></div>
  </header>

  <section class="deck panel" aria-label="Request settings">
    <form id="msg-form" autocomplete="off">
      <label class="label" for="msg">User message</label>
      <div class="msg-row">
        <input id="msg" name="msg" maxlength="160" spellcheck="false">
        <button class="btn-run" type="submit">Run</button>
      </div>
      <div class="presets" id="presets" aria-label="Example messages"></div>
    </form>
    <div>
      <span class="label">Sampler and stop settings</span>
      <div class="sampler">
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="temperature">Temperature <output id="temperature-out"></output></label>
          <input type="range" id="temperature" min="0" max="2" step="0.05">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="top-p">Top-p <output id="top-p-out"></output></label>
          <input type="range" id="top-p" min="0.05" max="1" step="0.01">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="penalty">Repetition penalty <output id="penalty-out"></output></label>
          <input type="range" id="penalty" min="1" max="3" step="0.05">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="top-k">Top-k (0 = off)</label>
          <input type="number" id="top-k" min="0" max="582" step="1">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="max-tokens">Max tokens</label>
          <input type="number" id="max-tokens" min="1" max="60" step="1">
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="seed">Seed</label>
          <div class="seed-row"><input type="number" id="seed" min="0" max="999999" step="1"><button type="button" id="new-seed">New</button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="ctl">
          <label for="stop-seq">Stop sequence</label>
          <input type="text" id="stop-seq" maxlength="20" placeholder="none" spellcheck="false">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="deck-foot">
      <span id="defaults-note">Defaults: temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.9, as in the generation_config.json of Llama 3 8B Instruct.</span>
      <button type="button" id="reset-settings">Reset settings</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="state panel" aria-label="Request state">
    <div>
      <div class="state-head"><span class="label">Context window</span><span class="meta" id="ctx-meta"></span></div>
      <div class="tokens" id="ctx-tokens"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="side">
      <div>
        <div class="state-head"><span class="label">KV cache</span><span class="meta" id="kv-meta"></span></div>
        <div class="kv-grid" id="kv-grid"></div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="state-head"><span class="label">Client receives</span><span class="meta" id="stream-meta"></span></div>
        <div class="stream" id="stream"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="bench">
    <nav class="rail panel" id="rail" aria-label="Pipeline stages"></nav>
    <section class="scope panel" id="scope" aria-labelledby="scope-title"></section>
  </div>

  <section class="lifecycle panel" id="lifecycle" aria-label="Token lifecycle"></section>

  <footer class="notes">
    <div>
      <h4>What is real here</h4>
      <p>The model is a real transformer with 296,256 parameters. It trained for about a minute on a laptop CPU, on 60,000 short chat transcripts about 16 animals. It knows those facts and little else, so other questions give confident nonsense.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <h4>What a real server does differently</h4>
      <p>A real server runs a model about 27,000 times larger on GPUs, with many requests in one batch, a paged KV cache, and fused kernels. This page runs one request in plain JavaScript. It feeds the prompt one position at a time, which gives the same numbers as one parallel prefill pass.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <h4>Source</h4>
      <p>The page, the engine, and the training script are in the <span class="mono">simulation/</span> folder of the research repository. Its README explains how to rebuild the model.</p>
    </div>
  </footer>
</div>
